canvas-stone.purpose: Warm stone canvas behind every page (OKLCH 96 / 0.005 / 95): neutral, not cream.

surface-white.purpose: Grid cells, ledgers and fields sitting on the canvas.

sunken-stone.purpose: Table heads, inset regions, hover rows.

well-stone.purpose: Product photo ground: cut-out photography sits on it, so a product reads on light stone here and on graphite in the dark theme from one image file.

muted-stone.purpose: Secondary text; 7.0:1 on surface, 5.7:1 on sunken.

rule-stone.purpose: Grid rules between cells and regions.

rule-strong.purpose: Control boundaries; at least 3.6:1 on every ground (WCAG 1.4.11).

on-primary.purpose: White on primary (7.95:1), as in the favicon mark.

brand-forest.purpose: Brand regions and illustration: CTA ground, ribbon, mesh nodes, masthead band. Constant across themes; not an interactive colour.

signal-amber.purpose: Trade signal: reserved, featured, active filter, the held quantity. Never the warning semantic.

signal-hover.purpose: Pressed and hovered signal fill; ink stays 7.7:1.

signal-stamp.purpose: Signal stamp fill: solid amber reads as a stamp on the pale grounds.

on-signal.purpose: Ink on signal (8.88:1). Signal is never text on the canvas (1.6:1).

signal-border.purpose: Edge of signal-marked regions: ink here, amber on the dark ground.

inverse-ink.purpose: Opposite of the ground: on-state chips, tooltips, the bulk-action bar. Light in the dark theme.

chrome-ink.purpose: Mastheads: ink in both themes, the darkest layer in the dark theme.

ring-contrast.purpose: Outer focus outline; the amber ring alone is 1.6:1.

shadow-ink.purpose: Base for overlay shadows only (menus, dialogs, toasts).

tone-success.purpose: Authoritative completed states stamp in the brand green.

tone-warning.purpose: Burnt orange, deliberately not yellow: yellow is the trade signal.

night-surface.purpose: Grid cells lift one step above the canvas.

night-sunken.purpose: Table heads, inset regions, hover rows: one step lighter than the cell, so hover lifts as it does in the light theme.

night-well.purpose: Product photo ground: the same cut-out photograph sits on graphite here.

night-rule.purpose: Grid rules between cells and regions.

night-rule-strong.purpose: Control boundaries; at least 3.5:1 on every ground including sunken.

night-primary.purpose: Forest lifted for a dark ground: 5.8:1 as text on surface.

night-primary-soft.purpose: Selected rows and active navigation; primary text on it is 4.7:1.

night-on-primary.purpose: Ink on primary (6.4:1). White fails on the lifted green.

night-signal-hover.purpose: Lighter amber on hover; ink stays above 10:1.

night-signal-stamp.purpose: On the dark ground a solid amber stamp is the loudest mark on the page; the stamp keeps an amber edge and text on the soft ground instead.

night-inverse.purpose: Opposite of the ground: light chips, tooltips and the bulk-action bar.

night-chrome.purpose: Mastheads sit below the canvas, the darkest layer.

night-ring-contrast.purpose: Outer focus outline in the foreground colour.

night-shadow.purpose: Base for overlay shadows; deeper than the canvas so lift still reads.

night-tone-warning.purpose: Burnt orange, lifted; still distinct from the amber signal.

display.purpose: Page titles (HeaderBlock) in Archivo SemiExpanded at the display weight (680, 640 dark), -0.02em; 30/36 below sm, 24/32 in compact headers.

display-market.purpose: MARKET hero at wide containers only: 52/56 stepping to 64/68.

headline.purpose: Section H2 on MARKET pages in the display width at 600, 38/44 in the CTA band on wide containers.

title.purpose: Panel and block titles at 700; 18/28 for panel and masthead names.

figure.purpose: The figure slot and money: display width, display weight, tabular, never wrapping; 18/28 in rows, 24/32 in cells, 38/44 in detail.

body.purpose: Archivo at width 100, the default interface text set on body.

body-reading.purpose: MARKET body and rich text, capped at 68ch.

data.purpose: Dense LEDGER cells and metadata, tabular.

label.purpose: The caps utility: uppercase muted column heads, definition terms, group captions. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono 400/500/600 via next/font (--font-jetbrains) behind font-mono: SKUs, item codes, order, quote, transaction and request ids only.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow) calc(10% * var(--shadow-weight)), transparent)
shadows.purpose: A flat bottom edge for the raised recipe surface (with the strong rule). Not a blur.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.value: 0 6px 16px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow) calc(12% * var(--shadow-weight)), transparent), 0 1px 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow) calc(8% * var(--shadow-weight)), transparent)
shadows.purpose: Only what sits above the page: dialogs, popovers, selects, menus, the notification panel, toasts, the command palette, chart tooltips.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: REVEAL: expose additional information. animate-reveal rises 4px.

motion.name: bind
motion.purpose: BIND: reserve, select, approve or commit. Control state changes.

motion.name: transfer
motion.purpose: TRANSFER: move through a commercial workflow. animate-transfer enters 8px.

motion.name: reflow
motion.purpose: REFLOW: respond to filter, sort or grouping.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: STAMP: confirm authoritative state; scales in from 1.06.

motion.name: thread
motion.purpose: THREAD: communicate process progression; connector draws from the left.

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: Loading status only: processing mark and busy buttons.

themes.choice: web/lib/theme.ts stores system | light | dark under localStorage "sokomesh-theme"; themeScript in web/app/layout.tsx applies it before first paint; ThemeSwitch (P-18) changes it.
themes.stateDeltas: Warm stone (OKLCH hue about 95) and warm graphite (about 107), both at chroma under 0.01; hover and selected lift one step against the surface in both themes.

tracking.name: caps
tracking.purpose: The only positive letter-spacing: uppercase labels (stamps, table heads, field captions).

tracking.name: display
tracking.purpose: Tightening for display headings at 2xl and above.

tracking.name: normal
tracking.purpose: Resets inherited caps tracking for lowercase details inside uppercase labels.

narrative.northStar: Woven Trade, built as trade infrastructure
narrative.overview:
SokoMesh draws a wholesale market as one connected commercial record. Three structural ideas carry the whole system. A **UNIT** is a bounded commercial object (product, quantity, order, shipment), drawn as a square cell in a ruled grid. A **THREAD** is movement between states, drawn as a connector whose stroke pattern (solid, dashed, dotted) says how far it has gone. A **STAMP** is an authoritative state, drawn as a small uppercase rectangle with a drawn mark. None of these is skeuomorphic: no fabric, no rubber-stamp texture, no woven backgrounds.

The interface should read as modern trade infrastructure, not a SaaS dashboard. Grounds are warm neutrals at very low chroma: warm stone by day, warm graphite at night, so the forest green and the trade yellow are the only saturated colours on the page. Content sits in **containers, not floating cards**: grid cells share one rule, sections sit between full-width rules, and nothing on the canvas casts a shadow. Corners follow one rule: containers, cells, dialogs and photo wells are square; what you press or what labels a state has a 2px corner. Commercial quantities (prices, holds, minimum orders, totals) are set large in the display width so they can be compared at a glance.

Forest green has two jobs kept apart: **primary** is the interactive green (actions, links, selection, chart columns) and lifts on the dark ground, while **brand** is the constant forest used for regions and illustration (the CTA band, the ribbon, the masthead band). Signal amber is the colour of trade attention: the applied filter, reserved stock, "your price", the held quantity, the unread mark, the inner focus ring. It is never a status. Type is one grotesque in two widths: **Archivo** at its normal width for every interface string, and its SemiExpanded width for headings and money figures, with JetBrains Mono for identifiers.

The system has three experience modes over the same primitives and tokens. **MARKET** (buyer discovery and purchase) is photography-led and comfortable. **LEDGER** (seller and admin work) is dense, numeric and ruled. **FLOW** (checkout, reservations, fulfilment, warehouse) is directional, state-heavy and compact, with large primary actions. Modes are set through density and recipe variants; themes through tokens. Components never branch on mode or theme.
keyCharacteristics: Modular rectangular composition: joined grid cells and full-width section rules, not gapped cards.
Square containers and media; 2px corners on controls and stamps; radios stay round.
Warm stone and warm graphite neutrals; restrained forest; amber held back for trade signals.
Borders over shadows: cells and panels are flat, only overlays cast a short shadow.
Prices and quantities large, tabular and labelled: "KES 1,740.00", "Price per pack".
Product photography as cut-outs on the theme's well; operational surfaces stay systematic and dense.
Six-verb motion grammar, 120 to 340 ms, no bounce, no large travel.

rules.name: The Named Meaning Rule
rules.body: An animation without a verb from this table is a defect, not a flourish. Hover does not scale anything.

rules.name: The Loading Exception Rule
rules.body: Two continuous animations exist and are bounded to loading status only: the spinner (`animate-spin`, 0.8s linear) and the skeleton pulse (`animate-skeleton`, 1.4s). They report system status, run only while work is pending, and are stopped by reduced motion.

rules.name: The Signal Is Not a Warning Rule
rules.body: Amber marks what the trader is attending to; it never means "caution" or "done". Warning is burnt orange; success is green.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Primary is for things you press or select and lifts with the theme; brand is for regions and illustration and stays constant.

rules.name: The Same Roles Rule
rules.body: A theme is a second value for each existing role, never a new role used by one theme only.

rules.name: The Paired Tone Rule
rules.body: A tone is used as its foreground-on-ground pair with a mark and a label. A coloured dot or tint alone never carries state (WCAG 1.4.1).

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Tailwind's default palette, radii, text sizes, tracking and shadows are cleared in `globals.css`; only SokoMesh tokens exist as utilities. Components contain no raw hex.

rules.name: The Visible Quantity Rule
rules.body: A record's commercial quantity is its loudest line. The projection's `figure` slot takes the first money field in the list fields (from the `currency` widget, never a field name), sets it in the display width with its field label underneath ("Price per pack"), and removes it from the meta list.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Tables, inputs, outputs and anything marked `data-numeric` use tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Identifier Face Rule
rules.body: Mono means "an identifier you could type back". Never set prose, prices or labels in it.

rules.name: The Label Is Not a Kicker Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label style names data. It never sits above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Coarse Pointer Rule
rules.body: Under `pointer: coarse`, control height rises to the 44px `touch-target`.

rules.name: The Different Composition Rule
rules.body: Narrow screens get a different arrangement, not a squeezed one: the public header moves search, sections and categories into a sheet; ledger columns drop out by container width; stat strips take as many columns as they have metrics.

rules.name: The Borders Carry Structure Rule
rules.body: Resting content is separated by rules and grounds. Nothing on the canvas casts a shadow to look important.

rules.name: The Rectangle Rule
rules.body: States, chips and filters are rectangles, never pills. No oversized rounded cards anywhere.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Focus Rule
rules.body: Every `:focus-visible` gets a 2px outline in `ring-contrast` at 2px offset around a 2px amber ring.

dos: Do take every value from `design/tokens/`; add a token before adding a value, and give it a value in both colour files.
Do compose repeated records as joined cells in one container, and pages as sections between full-width rules.
Do keep containers and media square and controls at 2px.
Do set the commercial quantity large through the `figure` slot, with its label.
Do put product photographs on the `well` as cut-outs, and keep operational surfaces systematic and dense.
Do reserve signal amber for trade attention, and use primary for what is pressed and brand for regions.
Do show money as "KES 1,740.00" with tabular numerals, the U+2212 minus and no wrap.
Do say "not confirmed" on every payment state that is not a successful phone result.
Do name each animation's verb and stay within 120 to 340ms, with no bounce.
Do check new colour pairs in `contrast.test.ts` for both themes.
Do label demo data and demo photographs as demo, and credit every CC BY and CC BY-SA photograph.
donts: Don't add glassmorphism, gradient backgrounds, decorative 3D, glow or floating orbs.
Don't use excessive pill shapes, oversized rounded cards or arbitrary bento layouts.
Don't float cards on the canvas with gaps and shadows; join them.
Don't make SokoMesh rustic: no textures, no hand-drawn ornament, no organic shapes in components. The organic share lives in photography and the ribbon.
Don't use the ribbon more than twice a page, behind text, or in LEDGER and FLOW surfaces.
Don't use amber or yellow for warnings or success.
Don't branch a component on the theme or on a model name.
Don't scale elements on hover or add continuous motion beyond the loading spinner and skeleton.
Don't set the uppercase label above a heading as an eyebrow.
Don't present demo SVG placeholders or demo photographs as real commerce.
